en.headline: Immigration Department arrests couple over suspected passport tampering
en.dek: A 27-year-old woman and her 34-year-old boyfriend were arrested in Lam Tin after laboratory tests confirmed human alteration to a SAR passport that had missing pages.
body: The Immigration Department arrested a couple late on 26 November in Ping Tin Estate, Lam Tin, on suspicion of illegally altering a Hong Kong SAR passport. The woman, aged 27 and reported to be a property agent, and her 34-year-old boyfriend, said to be a renovation worker, face allegations of altering a travel document without lawful authority, possessing and using a false or unlawfully altered travel document, and misleading Immigration Department officers.

The case arose after the woman claimed on social media that her 2018-issued passport had missing pages when she was refused entry to Japan and returned on the same flight. She later attended the Immigration Department in person, asserting the defect was a factory flaw that caused her to cancel a trip and lose money. Officers inspected the document, suspected human tampering, and sent it to the Government Laboratory.

Laboratory results confirmed the missing pages resulted from human alteration, with paper remnants found inside the passport. The manufacturer verified that the printing process had no defects or missing pages. The woman had told officers the passport had never been transferred to a third party. Immigration officers said the couple had previously travelled together to places including Taiwan, South Korea and Thailand without incident using the document. Investigations continue and further arrests are not ruled out.

zh.headline: 入境處拘捕情侶 涉非法改動特區護照
zh.dek: 27歲女子及其34歲男友在藍田平田邨被捕，政府化驗所證實護照缺頁屬人為造成，兩人涉嫌改動旅行證件等三罪。
body: 入境事務處於11月26日深夜在藍田平田邨拘捕一對情侶，涉嫌沒有合法授權而改動特區護照。27歲女子報稱任職地產代理，其34歲男友報稱裝修工人，兩人涉嫌無合法授權改動旅行證件、管有及使用非法改動的旅行證件，以及誤導入境事務隊人員。
事件源於女事主早前在社交媒體聲稱其2018年簽發的特區護照缺頁，在日本被拒入境並原機返港。她其後親身到入境處查詢，稱缺頁屬出廠瑕疵，導致取消行程及損失旅費。處方人員檢視證件後懷疑有人為改動，將護照送交政府化驗所化驗。
化驗結果證實缺頁由人為造成，護照內頁有紙碎殘留物。印製商確認印製過程無問題及無缺頁。女事主錄取口供時表示證件從未轉讓予第三者。入境處指兩人早前曾一同前往台灣、南韓及泰國等地使用該護照並無異常。調查仍在進行，不排除有更多人被捕。
